Test program that initializes an ipecho client, polls for a shred version, and logs the result.

# Purpose
This file contains a small C test program for the `fd_ipecho_client` API. It starts the runtime with `fd_boot`, allocates aligned memory for one client object, and creates the client with `fd_ipecho_client_new` and `fd_ipecho_client_join`. The program then initializes the client with a local IPv4 address and port, and repeatedly calls `fd_ipecho_client_poll` until it receives a shred version value. When the poll succeeds, it logs the returned shred version and exits.
